children: For thousands of years, The Blazing Claw has served as the symbol of piracy. Although innumerable variations of the symbol exist, they are all more or less adaptations of the same image: a fiery talon. This image has been romanticized somewhat on holovids, with the result that many average citizens hold pirates in high regard, but those who operate deep-space ships have no such illusions. To them, The Blazing Claw means just one thing: the threat of death.
